integrity: All infinite claims have analytic proofs and their exact finite algebra checks are independently reproducible. Independent audit or validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Real polynomial global smooth diffeomorphism need not have polynomial inverse.
The classification assumes degree at most three, SO(2) equivariance and a hyperbolically attracting origin.
Nonlinear maps have radially expanding outer trajectories; no dissipativity or robust isolated attracting cycles are asserted.
Earlier radial normal-form literature might implicitly overlap some portions.
title: Sharp global phase portrait and cubic degree threshold for rotational planar maps
